title: All phase manifests must use identical feature table column format including Cluster column
description: Phase 2 feature tables used columns {ID, Name, Priority, Dependencies, Description} while Phases 1 and 3 included a Cluster column. This inconsistency makes per-feature cluster membership unverifiable in Phase 2 and creates a documentation gap that space_split may need to work around.
root_cause: The manifest generation step (Phase 3.3) does not enforce a consistent table column schema across all phase manifests. Each phase's table format may vary depending on context or the specific generation path taken.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3, define a single canonical table column format: {ID, Name, Priority, Local Deps (this phase), Cross-Phase Deps, Cluster, Description}. Enforce this format for ALL phase manifests regardless of domain count or phase complexity.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Features by Domain tables
